transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this recorded pre-decision roundtable. As you know, HarborRoute Logistics has breached its quarterly minimum debt-service coverage ratio covenant and is requesting a temporary waiver to cover one reporting period while it completes a contract transition. The existing loan agreement requires a minimum DSCR of 1.20. The borrower has made all scheduled interest and principal payments on time. Before I make my underwriting decision, I need to hear from each of you on risk, legal, relationship coverage, and loan operations. Let's start with risk — what's your assessment of this waiver request?

transcript.text: My review this morning confirmed that a one-time contract-transition charge caused the covenant breach. I have not yet attached the review to the credit file, but I'll do so immediately after this roundtable.
